item.text: `DecodeHooks` is composed for `v.Unmarshal`, so putting the substitution hook first should let later hooks and type conversion see the resolved value. I’ll cover whole-value matching, unset variables, multiple fields, and existing `FLIPT_` overrides.

+var envReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+// envSubstitutionHookFunc resolves YAML values that reference an environment variable.
+func envSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from reflect.Kind, to reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		value := data.(string)
+		matches := envReference.FindStringSubmatch(value)
+		if matches == nil {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if replacement, ok := os.LookupEnv(matches[1]); ok {
+			return replacement, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}
+

item.text:
Added a decode hook that resolves YAML values matching `${VARIABLE_NAME}` before other conversions. Values with an invalid pattern, non-string values, and references to unset variables stay unchanged; existing `FLIPT_` overrides retain precedence.

Added tests for multiple references, integer port conversion, string values, and edge cases. `go test ./internal/config -count=1` passes.
